# 16x Prompt

> > 16x Prompt is an AI coding assistant platform offering API integration with ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, and other LLMs for software development workflows.

The site provides setup guides for various AI model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hyperbolic, DeepInfra), comparison analyses between AI coding tools, and educational content on AI coding evolution, token management, and enterprise adoption. Created by Zhu Liang, it serves developers seeking to optimize their AI-assisted coding workflows.

## Key Topics

- 16x Prompt
- ChatGPT
- Claude 3.5 Sonnet
- DeepSeek V3
- GPT-4o
- API configuration
- Token usage and limits
- AI coding tools
- Context windows
- LLM benchmarks
- GitHub Copilot
- Prompt engineering
- OpenRouter
- Developer tools
- Code completion

- [Guide](https://prompt.16x.engineer/guide): Setup guides for OpenAI, Claude APIs and LLM configuration in 16x Prompt
- [Comparisons](https://prompt.16x.engineer/comparisons): Compare 16x Prompt to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and aider for coding

- [Deep Infra Setup Guide](https://prompt.16x.engineer/guide/deepinfra): Configure DeepInfra API with DeepSeek V3/R1 models in 16x Prompt
